label: Free allowance idle while work runs over budget
means: Free or included allowances, unclaimed or under their limit, in a lane that has used all it includes this cycle.
goal_source: template goal, no public benchmark: 0 free or included allowance idle while work in its lane runs over budget; idle capacity there is money or speed left unused
source: params.allowances, with limits from params.systems_file, use from params.usage_file and claim status from the registry in params.registry (names, allowances and terms only)

params.comment: The org's allowances and what each could take over; the template lists none, so every metric is not measured until a repo names them. systems_file and usage_file: a relative path is from the Git Crafter checkout, ~/ is home. registry: a folder of free-tier registry files (registry_files), each { rows: [{ id, name, provider, lane, price_month, status, org_status, resets, checked, source }] }. claim_lanes: lanes whose unclaimed free rows are listed. lane_alias: row id to lane. lane_work: what an allowance in a lane could take over. allowances: [{ id, name, system, registry ('file#row'), allowance ({ label, value, unit, source, read }), usage (a usage_file metric id), used, status_override, lane, pool, resets, could_take_over, claim_needs }]. reader: how a --local collect reads its use, { github_billing: org, product } (gh api's org billing usage summary, gross USD this month), { plan_file, window } (the get_usage block a session writes; a day old is not read) or { provider: modal, huggingface, groq or openrouter } (that provider's own usage or limits call, its key from the collect's environment: MODAL_TOKEN_ID and MODAL_TOKEN_SECRET, HF_TOKEN, GROQ_API_KEY or OPENROUTER_API_KEY; a missing key is not read, never 0). A CI collect reads only huggingface and openrouter, with the HF_TOKEN and OPENROUTER_API_KEY that actions/pages' hf-token and openrouter-api-key pass, into credits.highest_used_share alone; every other metric stays not measured in CI. pool_metrics: metric id to the allowance id it reports. no_usage_api: allowance id or registry row ('file#row') to why no API reads its use; such a row needs no key made to read it, and counts as unreadable, never as pending a key. status_field: the registry field holding the org's claim status (could_claim, have or use), default org_status; status_override uses the same key.

label: Free allowances not claimed
means: Free tiers and credits in the lanes the repo uses that it could claim now and has not.
goal_source: template goal, no public benchmark: 0 free allowance in a lane the repo uses left unclaimed; near band: template default
source: the registry's claim status (params.status_field: could_claim, have, use) in params.claim_lanes, and params.allowances overrides

label: Most-used allowance this cycle
means: The highest share any read allowance outside the CI pools has used so far this cycle, a running total.
goal_source: template goal, no public benchmark: under 80% of each free limit leaves room for a spike before it bills or stops; near is the limit itself
source: params.usage_file against each allowance's limit, outside the pools

label: GitHub's included Actions, used and left
means: The org's included GitHub Actions minutes or spend used so far this cycle, every repo together.
goal_source: template goal, no public benchmark: under 80% of the plan's included Actions minutes or spend (docs.github.com/en/billing/concepts/product-billing/github-actions); near is the allowance itself
source: the allowance params.pool_metrics maps to this id (pool: true), its use this cycle from params.usage_file against what the plan includes

label: Claimed allowances whose use is read
means: Allowances the org holds whose use this cycle a collector reads, so idle capacity shows up the same day.
goal_source: template goal, no public benchmark: set 2026-11-04; an allowance whose use no one reads cannot be shown idle. The goal cannot be met while an allowance whose use no API reads (params.no_usage_api) is claimed
source: params.usage_file, against every claimed allowance in params.allowances; each unread allowance is named with why: no API reads its use (params.no_usage_api), it needs a key or login, or no reader exists yet

label: Oldest allowance figure
means: Days since the oldest allowance on this tab was read on its provider's own page.
goal_source: template goal, no public benchmark: free tiers change often, so a figure is re-read on its provider's page within a week; near: a month
source: read dates on the limits in params.systems_file and params.allowances, and the registry rows' checked field
